from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql="""WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, t.GenreId, g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
"""
Path('/work/query.sql').write_text(sql)
# Run read-only and report shape/types/sample, query plan, no mutation evidence via query_only.
p='/inputs/Chinook.sqlite'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
con.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
rows=con.execute(sql).fetchall()
print('bytes',len(sql.encode()),'rows',len(rows))
print('columns',[d[0] for d in con.execute(sql).description])
print('first',rows[:8])
print('types first', tuple(type(x).__name__ for x in rows[0]) if rows else 'no rows')
print('max per country', max((sum(r[0]==c[0] for r in rows) for c in rows), default=0))
print('plan:')
for r in con.execute('EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN '+sql): print(r)
con.close()

from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql=Path('/work/query.sql').read_text()
assert sql.lstrip().upper().startswith('WITH ')
assert sql.count(';') == 1 and sql.rstrip().endswith(';')
con=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro', uri=True)
con.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON')
ticks=0
def progress():
    global ticks
    ticks += 1
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress, 1000)
cur=con.execute(sql)
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('verified file:', Path('/work/query.sql').stat().st_size, 'bytes')
print('rows:', len(rows), 'approx VM instructions:', ticks*1000)
print('last row:', rows[-1] if rows else None)
con.close()
print('\n--- query.sql ---\n'+sql)
